verdict.rationale: BugSnag has no documented built-in natural-language interface. It does ship an official first-party MCP server (SmartBear MCP), and a self-hosted version supports OAuth 2.0 login, so users can operate BugSnag data through natural-language requests in an AI client. That route depends on an external agent, and the scope of supported operations is undocumented in the pack. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, documentation of which actions can be performed via natural language, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
